in_marathi.name: Diganta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sunrise, Brilliance, Radiance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Diganta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Diganta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dig' meaning sun and 'anta' meaning end or horizon. It represents the rising sun, a symbol of new beginnings and enlightenment. In Hindu mythology, Diganta is the name of the god Indra's chariot, which is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
